messages:
Maya (marketing): Quick recap: RefApp snack post went live at 09:15 PT. Early community interest — want to spin a short webinar + gated appendix to drive dev leads.
Evan (devrel): Nice. Any initial metrics?
Maya (marketing): 24h: 4.1k pageviews, 325 newsletter signups, 9 repo downloads, 5 demo requests.
Rhea (growth): Demo requests origin? company size?
Omar (content): 4 startups, 1 mid-market, 0 enterprise. Most signups via inline CTA.
Nia (ops): lead-bot: 2 leads failed routing due to missing "referrer" field -> parked in manual-review.
lead-bot: 2 leads missing "referrer"; flagged 'manual-review'.
Maya (marketing): Can we default missing referrer -> "organic" and tag as 'auto-defaulted'?
Nia (ops): Prefer default + flag. I'll patch mapping and reprocess today.
Evan (devrel): Also we should clarify benchmark language in the post. Current latency quoted was measured at batch=1 on dedicated. Add a callout about batching and throughput.
Omar (content): I'll add a bench note: "Latency numbers measured at batch=1 on dedicated small. Batching increases tokens/sec; see appendix for configs."
Rhea (growth): Proposal: gated webinar "RefApp deep-dive: code, infra, and benchmark lessons". Target 50-75 devs. Capture repo downloads and demo opt-ins.
Maya (marketing): Action items:
- Omar: update post with bench callout + add A/B CTAs (Register live vs Get repo + appendix) by EOD
- Nia: change routing default + reprocess the 2 leads (today)
- Evan: draft webinar outline + confirm speaker Rafael from runtime (tomorrow)
- Rhea: spin up registration page + $500 initial promo budget (48h)
Nia (ops): Reprocess command I'll run:
```bash
python infra/reprocess_leads.py --filter "missing_referrer" --assign default:organic --tag auto-defaulted
```
Evan (devrel): Draft agenda: 8m intro, 20m hands-on demo, 12m benchmarks & infra tradeoffs, 10m Q&A. Rafael, can you cover runtime tweaks and quantization notes?
Rafael (runtime): Yep, can do. Will prepare short config examples for dedicated vs hosted.
Rhea (growth): A/B CTA plan: Variant A "Join the live walkthrough" Variant B "Get the repo + benchmark appendix". Track CTR -> reg -> demo funnel.
Maya (marketing): Email drip cadence: immediate confirm, 4d reminder, 1d, 2h. Rhea to own emails.
Omar (content): I'll bold the bench callout so community readers don't misinterpret single-request latency as production throughput.
Nia (ops): Routing patch applied to staging, will push to prod after quick smoke in 20m. Will re-run reprocess after prod deploy.
Maya (marketing): Great. Please update this thread when tasks are done so SDRs can pick up the leads. :rocket:
